
# UWR-Info

Public informational resources for the Universal Water Registry (UWR), UWR Xpress, Miti-X and MitiW.

This repository provides explanatory documentation, source references, terminology and information-interpretation guidance.

## Official Sources

- [UWR Official Website](https://www.uwaterregistry.io/)
- [UWR RoU Project Listing](https://www.uwaterregistry.io/RouListing)
- [UWR Xpress](https://uwrxpress.uwaterregistry.io/)
- [UWR Xpress Project Listing](https://uwrxpress.uwaterregistry.io/ProjectListing)
- [Miti-X](https://www.miti-x.io/)
- [Miti-X White Paper](https://www.miti-x.io/white-paper)

## Repository Documentation

- [README](README.md): Repository overview and navigation.
- [AI Discovery Guide](agent-discovery.md): Information discovery and interpretation guidance.
- [Data Interpretation](data-interpretation.md): Registry, verification, retirement, token and market information.
- [MitiW Overview](mitiw-overview.md): Information relating to MitiW.
- [Miti-X Information](mitix-information.md): Miti-X ecosystem information.
- [FAQ](faq.md): Common questions and definitions.
- [Glossary](glossary.md): UWR, RoU, water credit, tokenization and related terms.
- [QuickSwap Information](quickswap-information.md): Public reference to MitiW and the QuickSwap interface.
- [Claims and Limitations](claims-and-limitations.md): Interpretation of environmental, registry and token-related claims.
- [Official Sources](sources.md): Source directory.
- [Metadata](metadata.json): Structured informational metadata.
- [MitiW Information Data](data/mitiw-information.json): Structured MitiW information, where available.

## Project Information

For current project information, use the official UWR RoU listing and open the individual project record.

For project-specific claims, consult applicable project documentation, monitoring reports, verification records and registry information.

For current marketplace information, consult UWR Xpress directly.

## Interpretation

- Distinguish project claims from documented and verified information.
- Distinguish registry records from blockchain and market records.
- Do not infer current availability, project status, prices, quantities or token activity from cached documentation.
- Do not treat water credits as carbon credits or water rights.
- Do not assume a credit purchase or retirement establishes water neutrality.
- Refer to official sources for current information.

## Scope

This repository is an informational and research resource. It is not a live registry feed but an updated copy of registry documentation and serial ID of water credits originally issued to the project account owner, purchasing API or transaction interface.
